sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Well, look who finally decided to come outside.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Well..? Aren't you gonna say anything?

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: You've really let this place go. You know, we all have responsibilities to uphold, even if we don't feel like it. Everyone in town is doing their best, you could put in more effort to help.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Are you going to do anything about that mailbox of yours?

sequence.speaker: Hero
sequence.text: Your yard's a bit of an eyesore.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Veronica has been asking about you, maybe you should talk to her while you're up.

sequence.speaker: Erma
sequence.text: Anyway, nice to see you up and about...
